text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: *pant*...! *pant*...! *pant*... aaah――

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Phew... ngh.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Huhhh? That's weird! I'm not hitting the 
target at aaall!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Waf~... At this rate, the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe is...――

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: ...All right, at times like this!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! The "Human Diary"!

text_block_list.name: Racing Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
Listen, Bu-chan. Your legs are just a 
teeny-tiny bit different from other 
girls'.

text_block_list.name: Racing Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
That's why with care... gentle care... 
both before and after you run... you have 
to take proper care of them.

text_block_list.name: Racing Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
—There, now you're all set! Now go on, run 
with all your might!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
(People are all so kind! When I said I 
wanted to run, they were the ones who made 
it possible!)

text_block_list.name: Familiar Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Look, Boo-chan! I recommend that one! You 
were looking for training wear that'd get 
you hyped up for solo practice, right?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! So cute! How did you know what I 
liked!?

text_block_list.name: Familiar Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I know~. I've watched what gets 
Boo-chan running energetically ever since 
we were little, after all.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...Hehehe, is that so! Thank you very 
much!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
(Humans don't run in races. Even so, they 
try so hard to understand how I feel... 
and think about me so much. It makes me so 
happy!)

text_block_list.name: Familiar Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Even so, you just keep getting bigger and 
bigger! I'm sure you'll win some 
incredible races. Do your best, Boo-chan!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: ! —Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: (I love people! So—it's only natural!)

text_block_list.name: Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Boo-chan, I heard. You joined the 
project to take on the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe?"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It's a big race, after all!

text_block_list.name: Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! So you've felt the romance 
of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe too!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, you've got it a bit wrong! It's not 
just me, it's everyone!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Because it's a dream that the people I 
love so much have wished for... forever 
and ever――

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I want to make it come true for them! Then 
everyone will be super happy, right?

text_block_list.name: Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, she'll definitely be thrilled! 
Thank you, Boo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text: If it's you, you can win!

text_block_list.name: Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I'm going to inspect the course. 
So that you... all of you, can run without 
a single worry!

text_block_list.name: Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
Then run with all your might... and grow 
strong for me, Bu-chan!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I want to become stronger. I want 
to make that wish come true!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Still... what matters the most is...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...I'm gonna test it! The current me! 
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—I knew it, it's gotta be <chrname>, right? To be 
chosen as the representative.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Right~, she's the top favorite after all. 
If someone were strong enough to beat her, 
they might have a chance, but...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's do that then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my way back after finishing training 
with <chrname> and walking her to the dorms—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait, waaaait!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Huh? Just Trainer? Oh well, whatever!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, in the next Inter-Representative 
Race! I want to beat you guys!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I take it back! We're not running 
together! It's a race!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Because, if I can't beat you guys when you 
look the strongest—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"I can't carry everyone on my shoulders! 
There's no way I can make everyone's 
wishes come true!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I'm serious. I'm going to win the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe!
